subject: Transfer of care: activation timeline & owner commitments
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Transfer of care: activation timeline & owner commitments

Hi Elena / Carlos —

Thanks again for the productive conversation last week. As discussed, I'm looping in Marcus (CS lead) and Ben (Solutions) so we can formalize the mutual action plan (MAP) and confirm owner-level commitments before the kickoff. Attached: Novus_MAP_v1.xlsx and a short SOW excerpt for reference.

Proposed high-level milestones (please confirm or flag changes):
- Contract signature & PO issued — target: 2026-09-20 — Owner: Novus Procurement (Carlos) / Redwood Sales (Grace)
- Implementation kickoff (technical) — target: 2026-09-14 — Owner: Redwood Solutions (Ben) / Novus IT (Carlos)
- CS onboarding & training (end-user admin + ops) — target: 2026-09-22 — Owner: Redwood CS (Marcus) / Novus Admin (Elena)
- Staged production launch (pilot) — target: 2026-10-05 — Owner: Novus Product + Redwood Ops
- Full go-live & acceptance sign-off — target: 2026-10-26 — Owner: Novus Program Lead (Elena)

Open items for confirmation from Novus: PO timing, compliance evidence (if any extra items beyond SOC2), and a preferred weekly sync cadence during the 6-week onboarding window.

Proposed next steps:
1) Novus confirms PO target and an internal approver by EOD 2026-09-03
2) Redwood to share the onboarding runbook and technical prerequisites by 2026-09-04 (attached as MAP_v1)
3) Schedule a 60-minute kickoff the week of 2026-09-14 — propose Tue 9/14 10am PT; please confirm availability

Attachments: Novus_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), SOW-excerpt.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to moving to handoff.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0131

Grace —

Thanks for the clear plan. We like the proposed structure but two constraints from our side:
1) Procurement needs to issue a PO (and our legal team to sign the SOW) before any technical kickoff; our internal timeline currently targets PO issuance by 2026-09-20, which aligns to your first milestone but means the technical kickoff may need to be pushed if approvals slip.
2) We want an additional optional "train-the-trainer" session included before staged pilot so our admin leads can run internal trainings. Can you add a 2-hour TTT session targetted for the week 2026-09-21?

Also attaching our PO template (PO_template.pdf) — please confirm Redwood's billing contact so procurement can circulate the PO.

Adding our CS onboarding plan and owner roster so expectations are explicit. I pulled the draft MAP into our shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cNovusOnboarding

Redwood CS proposed tasks / owners / dates (adjusted to account for procurement):
- Onboarding runbook (final) — due: 2026-09-10 — Owner: Marcus Lin (Redwood CS)
- Technical prerequisites checklist complete — due: 2026-09-12 — Owner: Ben Carter (Solutions) / Novus IT (Carlos)
- Tech kickoff (remote) — scheduled: 2026-09-16 10:00am PT — Owner: Ben Carter / Carlos Vega
- Admin training (train-the-trainer) — scheduled: 2026-09-22 2:00pm PT — Owner: Marcus Lin / Novus Admin (Elena)
- Pilot window (data sync + validation) — 2026-09-27 to 2026-10-04 — Owner: Novus Product + Redwood Ops
- Acceptance review (success criteria checklist) — due: 2026-10-08 — Owner: Novus Program Lead + Marcus Lin

Notes:
- If PO issuance slips past 2026-09-20 we will move the tech kickoff to the next week; we can keep the TTT session fixed as it’s low-risk to run prior to billing if Novus prefers.
- I'll own the onboarding runbook and will upload a version with explicit test cases for acceptance by 2026-09-10.

Thanks — Ben, can you confirm the environment prep ETA and whether you need Redwood infra access to be scheduled before 9/12?
